title: The hyperfinite II_1 factor is not quasidiagonal
summary: We construct an MF C*-algebra A such that the spatial tensor product of A and the hyperfinite II_1 factor R contains a proper isometry. Consequently, stable finiteness of C*-algebras is not stable under tensor product and the hyperfinite II_1 factor is not a quasidiagonal C*-algebra. The C*-algebra A is non-simple and has only non-faithful tracial states. This result was obtained using OpenAI's Chat GPT Pro 6.0.
